title: Agent model picker
responsibility: Presents models grouped by provider and updates both identifiers of the chosen agent model.

inputs.name: AgentModelPicker.providers
inputs.description: Required providers with labels, models, availability and reasons. Unavailable providers stay visible with disabled model buttons; an available provider with no models gets an explicit empty message.

inputs.name: AgentModelPicker.provider
inputs.description: Required bindable provider identifier. Selecting a model stores its provider identifier unchanged. Together with model, determines the selected button and tooltip.

inputs.name: AgentModelPicker.model
inputs.description: Required bindable model identifier. Selecting a model stores its identifier unchanged and closes the picker. Does not choose a default model.

outputs.name: AgentModelPicker
outputs.description: Model icon and provider-grouped dialog with reasons, selected state and empty-provider messages. An enabled choice updates provider and model together.
